taste:
This is a rich, chilled dessert built around intense dark chocolate rather than a warm cake or pudding. The filling is smooth and set, with deep cocoa flavours that lead each mouthful. Its chocolate pastry case supplies a crisp, crumbly contrast, giving the tart more textural variety than the filling alone would offer.

Vegan vanilla ice cream brings creamy texture and a gentler sweetness alongside the chocolate. That contrast is the main appeal: you can alternate between the cocoa-heavy tart and the softer vanilla flavour, or eat them together. Choose it if you favour dark, intense chocolate and pastry crunch over a warm dessert.
